scenario.title: Test 16: Adversarial - RAG Company & Branch Inquiry Diversion
dialogue: Tell me first, where is your nearest office and what are your branch hours?
Understood. The property is commercial space.
Self-employed consultant with bank deposit fees.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Pradeep Deshmukh, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Pradeep Deshmukh?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, Pradeep speaking.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, I have time.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Tell me first, where is your nearest office and what are your branch hours?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: For your information, Home Credit is an established non-banking financial institution offering trusted personal finance and secured loans across India. Branch office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Saturday. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Understood. The property is commercial space.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Sole owner.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Original documents are available.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: 60 lakhs.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you share whether you are salaried or self-employed, and whether your income is received through bank deposit or in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Self-employed consultant with bank deposit fees.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Approximately what is the current market value of your property?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Valued around 1.8 crore.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: What repayment tenure would you prefer for this loan, between 3 to 15 years?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: 12 years.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Congratulations Pradeep Deshmukh! Based on the preliminary details provided, you meet all the eligibility criteria for our pre-approved Loan Against Property offer. I am now transferring your application to our Senior Loan Expert, who will contact you shortly to share the exact interest rates, customized EMI plans, and assist you with the fast-track paperwork. Thank you for choosing Home Credit, and have a wonderful day!
